services.name: Charter Boats
services.desc: Share a fishing charter is a great opportunity to get all the benefits of a private charter at a reduced cost. The shared charter is great chance to make new friends. In the past we have had many clients that have shared a charter keep in touch and plan another fishing trip with us. Taking four people, is ideal, but we can usually squeeze in another with your party. We just want all our clients to feel they are equally important to us. Each person contributes his or her share making it possible for two folks from Illinois to fish with two from England or even join some locals who enjoy fishing with us and sharing a trip! A split charter allows a group of 2-3 to pair up with another group,

services.name: Dolphin Fishing
services.desc: The mahi mahi have started coming thru the Florida Keys, on April 4 on an afternoon trip we had our first sizeable catch of mahi mahi aboard Fin Chaser. It was a beautiful day and our anglers boated 17 mahi and 2 nice wahoo. It is great to see the mahi coming in this early. Also the reef and wreck fishing remains excellent, lots of large Amberjack, snapper and barracuda. May 1 we we can start keeping grouper and grouper fishing has been red Hot. blurb: Looking for your next big fishing adventure? There is no place on earth for that like Key Largo. The Florida Keys are not only known for the world’s best fishing grounds but the ability to accommodate fishing year round. Whether it’s reef or offshore fishing, there is no better fishing charter than Key Largo Fishing
